text:
Jason (Sales): Heads-up — DeltaHealth asked if we can do a 2-week air-gapped POC in their sealed network. Key asks: HSM-backed license activation, signed bundles, offline delta patches, and a clear rollback path. Also legal wants SBOM + CVE scan report. Any blockers on packaging or timing?
Maya (SE): We can do it but need to clarify model/artifact sizes and whether they want full image vs delta-only delivery. Typical flow: ship full signed bundle + optional weekly delta patches. For this POC we can prepare a single signed full bundle and 2 small delta patches.
Priya (Security): Quick security checklist for the customer: do they require customer-managed HSM (BYOHSM) or is a vendor-signed key OK? Also need to confirm SBOM format (we prefer CycloneDX), required attestation, and key rotation window. DeltaHealth's info_sec usually asks for PKI proof and signing key fingerprint.
Liam (Infra Ops): Implementation notes: for offline upgrades we require:
- signed manifest + bundle.sig (SHA256)
- manifest includes artifact id, compatible_with, and rollback checkpoints
- we can support delta chaining but recommend at most 2 chained deltas for the POC otherwise complexity increases
Sample manifest snippet:
```
{
  "artifact_id": "rdi-bundle-2026-03-01",
  "version": "2026.03.01",
  "compatible_with": ["runtime-2.1","quant-8bit"],
  "rollback_checkpoint": "snapshot-20260301",
  "signature": "sha256:..."
}
```
Maya (SE): For signature verification we provide a verifier command customers can run locally. Example:
```
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz
```
Priya (Security): CycloneDX SBOM + signed bundle covers a lot. Add that we will provide a CVE scan report for the bundled libs. But note: we cannot supply HSM firmware-level attestations unless customer provides an HSM with remote attestation support. If they need FIPS/HSM attestation, that adds ~5 business days to prep and a PS engagement.
Alicia (Account Exec): Pricing questions from the buyer: they asked whether airgap packaging is included in our enterprise tier or an add-on. For small POC we usually charge a flat $3k packaging + $1k per signed delta if we do manual signing and transport. HSM integration + onsite assist is PS time billed separately.
Jason (Sales): DeltaHealth also asked about upgrade cadence — they want quarterly patches but legal is insisting on a 30/60/90 day security patch timeline. Can we commit to quarterly major + out-of-band critical CVE patches?
Liam (Infra Ops): Yes — commit: quarterly major bundles, monthly security delta windows for critical CVEs. For out-of-band we can ship a signed hotfix delta and a patch manifest. Rollback mechanics: we rely on snapshot restore; we will include a `rollback_checkpoint` file in the manifest and provide a rollback script that verifies signatures before restore.
Priya (Security): Questions for customer to answer ASAP:
- Do you require customer-managed KMS/HSM (PKCS#11)?
- Required SBOM schema (CycloneDX or SPDX)?
- Max acceptable patch chain length and rollback RPO?
- Any policy on offline telemetry (we will not phone-home without explicit consent).
Maya (SE): Logistics: we need 3 business days to build a signed full bundle after they provide model tarballs and environment constraints. If they want our team to do signature generation with their public key, that's an extra day for key exchange and verification.
Alicia (Account Exec): Customer also asked about license activation window for offline installs — can we do time-limited activation tokens or HSM-wrapped license blobs?
Liam (Infra Ops): We support HSM-wrapped license blobs (PKCS#7 envelope). Activation flow: customer provides HSM public key -> we produce license blob signed to that key -> customer injects into node. Key rotation: recommend 90-day rotation for POC, 30-day for production-sensitive workloads.
Jason (Sales): Can someone draft the short checklist to send to DeltaHealth (key asks + deliverables + pricing + timeline)? I'll coordinate the kickoff.
Priya (Security): I'll draft the security checklist and required questionnaire answers (SBOM, CVE cadence, signature verification, attestation notes).
Maya (SE): I'll prepare the build steps and verifier scripts, plus replication steps for their infra.
Liam (Infra Ops): I'll outline upgrade/rollback runbook and sample manifests.
deploy-bot: artifact rdi-bundle-2026-03-01 created (pending signature) — upload link: s3://redwood-artifacts/prod/rdi-bundle-2026-03-01 (internal).
Jason (Sales): Great — Alicia, can you confirm pricing and PS availability for next week? Also looping in @DeltaHealth-POC to get initial env constraints. :thumbsup:
